item.statement: The transition from low-stress to high-stress regions involves a shift from dislocation climb to a regime dominated by dynamic recrystallization and precipitation, altering the deformation kinetics.
quotes: The alloy exhibited a stress-dependent transition from a low-stress region (LSR-region I) to a high-stress region (HSR-region II).
The LSR was characterized by a stress exponent of 5 to 6 and an average activation energy of 268 kJ mol −1 , whereas the HSR showed much higher corresponding values of 8.9–14 and 380 kJ mol −1 .
Microstructural examinations on the deformed samples revealed remarkable dynamic recrystallization at higher stress levels.
